en.title: Arm Metis: open-source framework and repository context

claims.text: Arm announced that its product security team developed and open-sourced Metis as an agentic security framework.
The announcement describes a retrieval-augmented generation architecture that combines language models with project-specific knowledge for security analysis.

evidence.quote: combines large language models (LLMs) with project-specific knowledge

claims.text: Arm은 자사 제품 보안 팀이 에이전트 보안 프레임워크 Metis를 개발하고 오픈소스로 공개했다고 발표했다.
